title: Root account without MFA
fix: Enable hardware/passkey MFA on root; store securely.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: root MFA); MITRE T1078.004

title: Root account has access keys
fix: Delete root access keys; use IAM roles.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: no root access keys)

title: Security group exposes admin/DB ports to the internet
fix: Remove world access; use SSM Session Manager / bastion / VPN, or restrict to known CIDRs.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Networking: no 0.0.0.0/0 to admin ports); MITRE T1133

title: Security group exposes admin/DB ports to the internet
fix: Remove world access; use SSM Session Manager / bastion / VPN, or restrict to known CIDRs.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Networking: no 0.0.0.0/0 to admin ports); MITRE T1133

title: S3 bucket policy is public
fix: Remove public principals; serve public content through CloudFront with OAC.
references: MITRE T1530 (Data from Cloud Storage)

title: Kerberoastable privileged account
fix: Use gMSA for services; otherwise 25+ char random password, AES-only encryption, and remove privileged rights.
references: MITRE T1558.003 (Kerberoasting)

title: Kerberoastable privileged account
fix: Use gMSA for services; otherwise 25+ char random password, AES-only encryption, and remove privileged rights.
references: MITRE T1558.003 (Kerberoasting)

title: Legacy authentication not blocked
detail: no enabled policy blocks exchangeActiveSync + other client apps for all users
fix: Create CA policy: All users, client apps = Exchange ActiveSync + Other clients, Grant = Block.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline (legacy auth); MITRE T1110.003

title: Admin without any MFA method
fix: Require MFA registration via Conditional Access; prioritize admins.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline (Entra ID); CSF 2.0 PR.AA-03; MITRE T1078.004

title: Guest account holds privileged role
fix: Remove privileged roles from guest/external accounts.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline

title: Console user without MFA
fix: Require MFA (or move users to IAM Identity Center with SSO + MFA).
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: MFA for console users)

title: Access key not rotated
fix: Rotate or replace with role-based temporary credentials.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: rotate keys ≤ 90 days)

title: Access key not rotated
fix: Rotate or replace with role-based temporary credentials.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: rotate keys ≤ 90 days)

title: Access key not rotated
fix: Rotate or replace with role-based temporary credentials.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: rotate keys ≤ 90 days)

title: Full admin (*:*) attached directly to IAM user
fix: Grant admin only via roles assumed with MFA (or IAM Identity Center permission sets); attach policies to groups/roles, not users.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: no *:* policies); least privilege

title: Full admin (*:*) attached directly to IAM user
fix: Grant admin only via roles assumed with MFA (or IAM Identity Center permission sets); attach policies to groups/roles, not users.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: no *:* policies); least privilege

title: No multi-region CloudTrail trail
fix: Create an organization/multi-region trail to a locked-down logging account.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Logging: CloudTrail all regions)

title: S3 Block Public Access not fully enabled
fix: Enable all four Block Public Access settings (account and bucket level).
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Storage: S3 Block Public Access)

title: Stale enabled account
fix: Disable after confirming with the manager; delete after 30 days.
references: CIS Controls v8.1 5.3; MITRE T1078.002

title: krbtgt password not rotated
fix: Rotate krbtgt twice (allowing replication between resets) at least every 180 days and after any DA compromise.
references: MITRE T1558.001 (Golden Ticket)

title: Kerberos pre-authentication disabled (AS-REP roastable)
fix: Enable Kerberos pre-authentication.
references: MITRE T1558.004 (AS-REP Roasting)

title: Unconstrained delegation on user account
fix: Remove unconstrained delegation; use resource-based constrained delegation; mark admins 'sensitive and cannot be delegated'.
references: MITRE T1558 / T1134

title: Too many Domain Admins
detail: 6 members: Administrator, xw-admin, svc_sql, old.helpdesk, jdoe.admin, vendor.it
fix: Reduce to 2-4 named admin accounts; delegate with least-privileged groups; adopt a tiered admin model.
references: Microsoft AD tiering guidance; CIS Controls v8.1 5.4

title: Admin roles not required to use phishing-resistant MFA
fix: CA policy: include directory roles (Global Admin, Privileged Role Admin, etc.), Grant = authentication strength 'Phishing-resistant MFA'.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline

title: User without MFA registered
fix: Require MFA registration via Conditional Access; prioritize admins.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline (Entra ID); CSF 2.0 PR.AA-03; MITRE T1078.004

title: Admin lacks phishing-resistant MFA
fix: Register FIDO2 security keys / passkeys or WHfB; enforce 'Phishing-resistant MFA' auth strength for admin roles.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline; OMB M-22-09; NIST SP 800-63B-4 (phishing resistance)

title: Global Administrator count outside recommended range
detail: 6 members (policy 2-4; CISA SCuBA allows at most 8)
fix: Use least-privileged roles (User/Exchange/Security Admin) and PIM just-in-time activation.
references: CISA SCuBA M365 baseline (privileged access)

title: Privileged role assigned to on-prem synced account
fix: Use cloud-only admin accounts so an AD compromise can't escalate to the cloud tenant.
references: Microsoft privileged access guidance; CISA SCuBA M365 baseline

title: Privileged role assigned to on-prem synced account
fix: Use cloud-only admin accounts so an AD compromise can't escalate to the cloud tenant.
references: Microsoft privileged access guidance; CISA SCuBA M365 baseline

title: Root account used recently
fix: Reserve root for break-glass tasks; alert on root use.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: avoid root use)

title: Unused active access key
fix: Deactivate and delete unused keys.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: disable unused credentials ≥ 45 days)

title: Unused active access key
fix: Deactivate and delete unused keys.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM: disable unused credentials ≥ 45 days)

title: Stale console password
fix: Disable console access for inactive users.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM)

title: CloudTrail log file validation disabled
fix: Enable log file integrity validation.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Logging)

title: S3 Block Public Access not fully enabled
fix: Enable all four Block Public Access settings (account and bucket level).
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Storage: S3 Block Public Access)

title: Stale enabled account
fix: Disable after confirming with the manager; delete after 30 days.
references: CIS Controls v8.1 5.3; MITRE T1078.002

title: Privileged account with non-expiring, aged password
fix: Privileged passwords should be managed (PAM/LAPS) or rotated on compromise; enforce 15+ chars + MFA.
references: NIST SP 800-63B-4; CIS Controls v8.1 5.2

title: Privileged account with non-expiring, aged password
fix: Privileged passwords should be managed (PAM/LAPS) or rotated on compromise; enforce 15+ chars + MFA.
references: NIST SP 800-63B-4; CIS Controls v8.1 5.2

title: Privileged account with non-expiring, aged password
fix: Privileged passwords should be managed (PAM/LAPS) or rotated on compromise; enforce 15+ chars + MFA.
references: NIST SP 800-63B-4; CIS Controls v8.1 5.2

title: Conditional Access policy left in report-only mode
fix: Review sign-in impact and switch to On.
references: CSF 2.0 PR.AA-05

title: Conditional Access policy with many user exclusions
fix: Limit exclusions to break-glass accounts; review quarterly.
references: CSF 2.0 PR.AA-05

title: User relies only on SMS/voice/email MFA
fix: Move users to Authenticator with number matching or passkeys; SMS is vulnerable to SIM swap.
references: NIST SP 800-63B-4 (restricted authenticators)

title: User has two active access keys
fix: Keep at most one active key per user.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (IAM)

title: CloudTrail logs not encrypted with KMS CMK
fix: Encrypt with a customer-managed KMS key.
references: CIS AWS Foundations (Logging)

title: S3 versioning disabled
fix: Enable versioning (and Object Lock for backups) to survive ransomware/deletion.
references: CSF 2.0 PR.DS-11

title: S3 versioning disabled
fix: Enable versioning (and Object Lock for backups) to survive ransomware/deletion.
references: CSF 2.0 PR.DS-11
